ruleDefinitions.name: Invoke-Obfuscation COMPRESS OBFUSCATION
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects Obfuscated Powershell via COMPRESS OBFUSCATION

sequences.query: ((process_command_line = RGX(".*new\\-object.*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*text\\\.encoding\\]\\:\\:ascii.*")) AND (process_command_line = RGX(".*system\\\.io\\\.compression\\\.deflatestream.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*system\\\.io\\\.streamreader.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*readtoend\\(.*")))
